[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips and recipes for making Quarterback Rings and End Zone Nachos.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided detailed recipes for:  
**Quarterback Rings**:  
- Ingredients: 1 large onion, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, 1 cup buttermilk, vegetable oil for frying.  
- Tips: Soak onions in buttermilk, spice up the flour, dredge and double-dip, fry to perfection, serve with a dipping sauce.  

**End Zone Nachos**:  
- Ingredients: 1 bag tortilla chips, 1 cup shredded cheese, 1 can refried beans, 1 lb ground beef, 1/2 cup diced onion, 1/2 cup diced bell pepper, 1 jalapeño pepper, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper, optional toppings.  
- Tips: Prep toppings, assemble nachos, add cheese, bake until golden, add favorite toppings.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to make Quarterback Rings as an appetizer and End Zone Nachos as the main snack.
